item.title: Shilpa Shetty: Bombay High Court Issues Strict Order Over Image Tampering
item.description: Shilpa Shetty: The Bombay High Court has taken a tough stand in a serious case involving Shilpa Shetty. The court expressed its displeasure over AI-generated and altered photos of the actress, calling them extremely disturbing and shocking. The court issued clear instructions that social media platforms and websites immediately remove all such links and content to protect Shilpa Shetty's privacy and reputation.
